# Public test fixtures

This directory must contain only synthetic data generated by the project or
assets whose redistribution license and provenance are documented alongside the
asset.

The preferred sidecar is `<asset>.license.json`:

```json
{
  "license_spdx": "CC0-1.0",
  "generated_by": "the repository script or asset source"
}
```

The SPDX identifier must be on the repository scanner's reviewed allowlist,
and provenance must be a meaningful string. A plain `LICENSE` sidecar must
contain explicit `SPDX-License-Identifier:` and `Source:` fields. License
metadata does not replace consent or model/property releases for recognizable
subjects.

The M0 imaging tests intentionally commit no binary image fixture. They create a
deterministic 16-bit PPM gradient in a temporary directory at test time, verify
it, and delete it when the test process exits.

Never copy personal photographs, production projects, camera originals, model
weights, or metadata exports into this directory.
